fast.summary: Default exploration mode for new sprite branches. Favor speed, visual taste checks, and early rejection over deep QA.
rules: Judge visual appeal and motion read early.
Reject weak branches quickly instead of deepening them.
Do not start pair-expansion, publish-pack, nukki restitch, or runtime wire-up until a candidate already looks promising.

precise.summary: Promotion mode for candidates that already look good and are likely to ship.
rules: Use full QA, frame expansion, publish-pack, nukki, and runtime handoff when needed.
Prefer strip QA, gameplay-scale comparison, and explicit promotion gates.
Use only after the user asks for depth or when a candidate is already near runtime acceptance.
